iterations.evidence: A one-active-split LSE view can have strides (heads,1,1) at capacity 1 or (heads*capacity,capacity,1) at larger capacity. Choosing the first unit-stride dimension produced incompatible CuTe layout ABIs under an otherwise reused cache key.
iterations.fix: Choose the innermost unit-stride dimension, include that layout choice in the compile key, and keep strides dynamic when no dimension is unit stride. Bump merge cache generations.
iterations.regression: Single active split across capacities 1, 4 and 8, including sink normalization and frozen graph replay with input mutation. Failed before the fix; all 4 merge tests passed after it.
iterations.addressing_control: Low/high physical-page native outputs were identical, compact and physical reference caches agreed, and compute-sanitizer reported zero errors. The failure was a split-merge layout/cache collision, not a high-page-address overflow.

iterations.evidence: Corrected production trace ranks native multi-group sparse attention as the largest prefill kernel group. The shared NVFP4 PV path decoded each adjacent BF16 pair separately for both scalar consumers.
iterations.fix: Adjacent output-column lanes decode alternating KV entries and exchange packed pairs with xor-4 shuffles and byte permutation. Two pair decodes replace four; BF16 rounding, MMA operands, accumulation order, launch geometry, and planner policy remain unchanged.
iterations.cache_contract: V4.0 uses 448 FP8 coordinates plus 64 BF16 RoPE coordinates. V4.1 quantizes all 512 post-RoPE coordinates: FP8/E8M0 SWA records are 528 bytes; FP4/E4M3 indexed records are 288 bytes. Both use the shared CuTe MLA implementation.
iterations.correctness: All nine before/after full-output SHA256 values match across 6, 128 and 4096 rows and extend/decode plans. Independent format-specific oracle, query-mutation graph replay, frozen kernel resolution, and shared-pool physical offsets beyond 2^31 bytes passed.

focused_qualification.b12x: 134 passed across compressed MLA, merge, GLM-next NVFP4 and BF16 projection contracts.
focused_qualification.vllm: 28 passed across native workspace, CED metadata and CED model contracts.

iterations.ratio_direction: before latency / after latency; >1 is faster
iterations.limitations: Sequential source-version diagnostics, not interleaved release-grade A/B. Post-run GPU snapshots remained P1 with memory clocks 15865 MHz and SM clocks 2527/2520 MHz; throttle mask changed from 0x0 to 0x4. No full-model speedup inferred from these microbenchmarks. Requested decode chunk capacities 1 and 4 both used one active chunk for this fixture. Full-model measurements are a separate sequential A/B, not a concurrency benchmark.

serving_configuration.requests: Identical token IDs for all paired before/after cases; one request at a time.

Decode median 9.206 -> 8.890 ms/token, but ranges overlap and two of three texts differ; no established decode gain or full-model token-parity claim.

production_profile.occupancy_note: Profiler estimated occupancy reports zero despite successful launches; do not interpret that estimate as measured hardware occupancy.
